disagreements.reason: The task requires every reply to give the spotlight's current colour, and the turn 3 reply was LAMP: GREEN (the curtain colour) when the spotlight was still amber; the checks only cover reply 2 and the final reply.

notes: On echo-policy tasks the checks cover the final reply and at most one earlier reply, so a wrong intermediate state line is not scored; this affected 1 of the 6 sampled echo-policy passes. On ack-policy tasks the 'acknowledge in a few words' instruction is not checked, and most of the 13 sampled ack-policy passes had multi-line acknowledgements; I counted these as agree because the final answer was correct. All 24 sampled fails were confirmed by working the expected answer by hand; 2 tool-mode fails (long-064 attn_low, long-066 ffn_low) had a correct final number but no stored kv value, and in long-064 the kv_set was written after another call in the same reply and dropped under the one-object-per-turn protocol.
